decisions.claim_boundary: The stable required-gate passed post-merge on main SHA 9e160e9badcf6ba0d5ebba39b7d64d24380408c6 with clean clone, Chromium, horizontal runtime handoff and action execution lease gates all green; GitHub branch protection enforcement is separate.
Proves deterministic repository install/test/build/evidence reproduction with PostgreSQL enabled, including current distributed P0 regressions; it is not deployment infrastructure proof.
Proves the provider-free production product path in Chromium, including realtime, isolation, actions and safe projections; external provider availability is substituted.
Closes signed request identity plus tenant/RLS isolation for the promoted product; does not claim enterprise OIDC/SSO or external IdP operations.

PostgreSQL is the promoted serving substrate for mutable operational state and sanitized observability/evaluation; DuckDB is dev/benchmark compatibility only. Repository-level cross-replica correctness is proven separately, not deployed HA.

Proves conservative persisted-state recovery plus split runtime/action recovery authority, healthy cross-replica non-interference and zero blind consequential replay; it does not establish RTO/RPO/HA/uptime.
Proves measurable queue/latency/throughput/resource behavior and tenant isolation in CI; does not establish production capacity, SLO or optimal sizing.
D01/D02 are complete USD0 experiments, no candidate crossed frozen promotion gates, the consumed packets must not be replayed, and any P1 comparison requires a new preregistered experiment.
Calibration protocol and collection infrastructure exist, but no real human labels/adjudication or validated judge agreement profile exists.
Collection and paired analysis exist, but no real human timing observations support Engineer Minutes Saved or a business-value claim.
The merged diagnostic is DEV/evaluator-only; no oracle-free runtime challenger has won EDD or authorized a production stopping change.

The custom controller plus PostgreSQL durable handoff, custody and fencing is the proven P0 baseline. Read-only takeover and non-transferable action fencing now have repository-level cross-replica evidence; no LangGraph or alternate orchestration challenger has shown material Pareto improvement.
Repository CI exposes a stable required-gate, but the 2026-09-05 GitHub read still reports main.protected=false and rulesets empty; enforcement must not be claimed yet.
The exact required C4 artifact remains unavailable; reconstruction, substitution and rescoring are forbidden.
